name: headless-workers
description: Run headless Claude Code workers as managed subagents from Claude Code: start one in the background and get a handle at once, read a compact log of what it did, wait for its result in one call that also wakes you when it stalls, retries or hits a rate limit, steer it with a message while it runs, stop and resume it, run several as one group with a git worktree per writer, and collect text or schema-shaped JSON. Each turn is pinned to a read-only, write or auto permission profile; a read-only worker can run your tests while your tree stays untouched.
